items.body: It's not a standalone product, but rather part of the SigmaCX ecosystem. It's the platform's intelligent engine: it operates across all channels, executing actions to resolve end-to-end demands, combining context, automation and personalization.

cases.title: Solutions we build together
cases.btgLead: With a voice architecture built on **four layers of redundancy** and critical routes across two continents, BTG Pactual turned every call into a stable, secure and transparent experience.

btgResults.title: Average latency
btgResults.body: Reduction in voice traffic latency: faster, more stable communication with clients and investors.

btgResults.title: Encrypted traffic
btgResults.body: All traffic protected end to end (TLS), including the contingency routes outside the private network.

btgResults.title: Three critical routes live
btgResults.body: TLS São Paulo, TLS Atlanta and ECX activated in under two months, with zero impact on operations.

btgResults.title: Layers of redundancy
btgResults.body: Main connection, physical backup, internet contingency and georedundancy in Atlanta keep service uninterrupted.

cases.btgQuote: Solid infrastructure as a competitive advantage.
cases.conexionLead: With Linda, its AI agent on WhatsApp, and the integration between Dialogi and Wooba, ConexiónTS automated its quotation workflow and gained **agility, scale and a lower AHT** without losing personalisation.

conexionResults.title: Lower AHT
conexionResults.body: Answers in seconds through automation, replacing a slow, manual quotation process.

conexionResults.title: More scalability
conexionResults.body: The operation tripled its service capacity with the same team.

conexionResults.title: Projected growth
conexionResults.body: With fast, accurate answers, more quotes turn into sales.

conexionResults.title: Average response time
conexionResults.body: 24/7 service with instant quotes and communication tailored to each client's profile.

cases.conexionQuote: Technology and empathy in a single workflow.
cases.tecbanLead: Sigma Insights has transformed call management with automated analytics, bringing operational efficiency and higher customer satisfaction.

tecbanResults.title: Positive customer sentiment
tecbanResults.body: Satisfaction grew from 4% in 2023 to 46% in 2025; neutral interactions fell from 90% to 22%.

tecbanResults.title: Less silence on calls
tecbanResults.body: Silence dropped from 29% to 25%, making interactions more objective.

tecbanResults.title: Greater operational efficiency
tecbanResults.body: Adjustments found by the analyses cut 23 seconds from handling time in specific flows.

tecbanResults.title: Fewer callbacks
tecbanResults.body: Script changes reduced the volume of repeat contacts.

cases.tecbanQuote: When listening to the customer turns into business results.
cases.lead: Results measured in the operations of companies already running SigmaCX.
